{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop QA orders (revenue_clean == 999999.99)
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Now, filter for loyal customers only
loyal_customers = sales_clean[sales_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion fraction: number of converted orders / total loyal orders
n_converted = loyal_customers['converted'].sum()
n_total = len(loyal_customers)
conversion_fraction = n_converted / n_total

# Verify the premises
assert 'loyal' in loyal_customers['customer_segment'].unique(), "customer_segment 'loyal' not found in filtered data"
assert n_total > 0, "No loyal customers found"

print(f"Number of loyal customers: {n_total}")
print(f"Number of converted loyal customers: {n_converted}")
print(f"Conversion fraction among loyal customers: {conversion_fraction:.4f}")"}
